headline: De Paul's telepathic assist reveals unique bond with Messi, easing superstar's burden
summary: Rodrigo De Paul's unwavering devotion has provided Lionel Messi with a vital anchor, allowing the football legend to shed the immense pressure he carried for years, as seen in their recent game-winning play.
details: In a recent match in Kansas City, Rodrigo De Paul delivered a spectacular pass through four defenders, setting up Lionel Messi for a crucial goal. The moment highlighted their unique on-field chemistry, with Messi later seen wiping tears, attributing them to personal struggles unrelated to football.

De Paul has been described as Messi's 'natural satellite,' providing the essential support that the football legend lacked during earlier difficult phases of his career. This symbiotic brotherhood began forming when De Paul joined the Argentine national team in 2018 with a focus on protecting Messi's genius.

Unlike Messi's club-level friendships, De Paul's devotion is described as rarer, even leading him to follow Messi to Inter Miami, defying a conventional European career path. This move prompted fans to humorously call him Messi's 'second bodyguard,' emphasizing his constant presence.

For over two decades, Messi carried the immense expectations of his homeland, often feeling isolated despite his prowess. De Paul's tireless efforts on and off the pitch have helped lift this burden, allowing Messi to enjoy the game more freely, according to De Paul.

Messi's quiet leadership and acts of altruism, such as surrendering a penalty or financing staff wages, have fostered a collective, ego-free environment within the Argentine squad. De Paul acknowledges Messi's ability to manage and lead the group forward, further solidifying their bond.

headline: Ghana secures 1-0 victory over Panama with a last-gasp goal in World Cup Group L opener
summary: Caleb Yirenkyi scored in the 95th minute, earning Ghana crucial three points in their bid to reach the knockout stage for the first time since 2010. This dramatic win sets a strong start for their World Cup campaign.
details: Caleb Yirenkyi scored deep into stoppage time, securing a 1-0 victory for Ghana over Panama in their World Cup Group L opener on Wednesday. This crucial win provides Ghana with three vital points as they aim for the knockout stage, a feat not achieved since 2010.
The decisive goal came in the 95th minute. Thomas-Asante skillfully bypassed Panama defender Jose Cordoba before delivering a pass into the area, which the 20-year-old Yirenkyi converted.

Panama made a desperate attempt to equalize, throwing players forward for a late free kick, but Ghana's defense held firm. Earlier, Ghana goalkeeper Lawrence Ati Zigi made an excellent save from Cecilio Waterman's curling strike in the second minute but was later replaced due to injury.
Ghana is now set to face Group L leaders England in their next match. Panama will look to secure their first World Cup win when they take on Croatia.
caption:
Caleb Yirenkyi's 95th-minute goal sealed a dramatic 1-0 victory for Ghana against Panama in their World Cup Group L opener!

Caleb Yirenkyi scored deep into stoppage time, securing a 1-0 victory for Ghana over Panama in their World Cup Group L opener on Wednesday. This crucial win provides Ghana with three vital points as they aim for the knockout stage, a feat not achieved since 2010.

The decisive goal came in the 95th minute. Thomas-Asante skillfully bypassed Panama defender Jose Cordoba before delivering a pass into the area, which the 20-year-old Yirenkyi converted.

Panama made a desperate attempt to equalize, throwing players forward for a late free kick, but Ghana's defense held firm. Earlier, Ghana goalkeeper Lawrence Ati Zigi made an excellent save from Cecilio Waterman's curling strike in the second minute but was later replaced due to injury.

Ghana is now set to face Group L leaders England in their next match. Panama will look to secure their first World Cup win when they take on Croatia.
